description: agent-notes/Publishing-To-PyPI.md is the runbook for .github/workflows/publish.yml: it documents the v* tag trigger, the master-ancestry guard, trusted publishing via OIDC (no API tokens), the `environment: pypi`, the pending-publisher claim fields (Owner/Repo/Workflow=publish.yml/Environment=pypi), and the build->publish job split. Changing the workflow's trigger, guard, environment name, or publish mechanism must update the runbook, or the documented release procedure silently misleads.
